THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Extra-Chicken Bonus Lunch

When the grocery pack of chicken has more than dinner needs, save one spare boneless skinless chicken breast for an 8-minute air-fryer lunch with Hot Honey Mustard.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME8 min air-fry at 375°F
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVINGSee nutrition notes
KEY TO SUCCESS: Instead of recalculating a dinner recipe when a grocery pack has an extra breast, keep the dinner recipe as written and save the spare breast for lunch.

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 1 boneless, skinless chicken breast (the spare breast from a larger dinner pack)
  • Your favorite chicken seasoning, to taste
  • A half-second spray of avocado oil
  • Your favorite dipping sauce, as desired (filmed: Trader Joe’s Hot Honey Mustard)

Allergens: mustard.

Your grocery pack of chicken breasts weighs more than the dinner recipe calls for and you want a fast, zero-math lunch instead of scaling the dinner sauce.

Method

  1. 1.SLICE THE SPARE BREAST. Cut the spare boneless, skinless chicken breast into thin, evenly sized strips.
  2. 2.SEASON & SPRAY. Season the strips to taste and coat lightly with a half-second spray of avocado oil.
  3. 3.AIR-FRY AT 375°F. Arrange in a single layer in the air-fryer basket. Air-fry at 375°F for about 8 minutes until cooked through and the thickest strip reaches 165°F on a food thermometer.
  4. 4.PLATE & DIP. Transfer the hot chicken strips to a plate and serve with your favorite dipping sauce (Trader Joe’s Hot Honey Mustard shown).

Keys to success

  • Check the thickest strip with a food thermometer to confirm 165°F; cook time can vary slightly with strip thickness and air-fryer model.
  • No exact calorie or protein figure is published for this build because the spare chicken breast and dipping sauce were not weighed.

Storage and reheating

Store: Keep the spare raw chicken breast refrigerated in an airtight container and cook within 1–2 days, or air-fry ahead and refrigerate cooked strips for up to 3–4 days.

Reheat: Reheat cooked strips in the air fryer at 350°F for 2–3 minutes just until warm.

Lasts: Best air-fried fresh in 8 minutes; cooked strips keep 3–4 days refrigerated.

Estimated nutrition

No exact calorie or protein count is claimed for this recipe. The spare chicken breast and dipping sauce were not weighed, and a timed half-second spray of avocado oil is not a measured weight. If you want to log your own plate, weigh your raw chicken breast and measure your dipping sauce on the scale.
